dataset: NHANES 2015-2016 BPX_I and DEMO_I official public-use files
question: Does adding a second distinct physical reading improve prediction of a withheld third reading from the same examination under the testable conditional independence model?
relationship_to_goal: Empirical validation of a specific within-session measurement-depth ordering and error-model calibration. It does not establish broad biological reconstruction or validate every AniBench category.
prior_knowledge: Earlier NHANES 2017-2018 demographic/chemistry inverse-prediction pilot was negative/mixed. That result is retained. This different-cycle, direct-repeat experiment was selected after that result, not preregistered before the project; its protocol is frozen before reading these XPT records.

targets.valid: finite nonnegative; zero is a documented value and is retained

eligibility: Age at least20, positive finite MEC weight, finite masked stratum/PSU, all first3 readings valid for both targets. Common complete-case cohort. No fourth reading, value-based trimming, imputation or external linkage.

split.unit: joint masked stratum/PSU; all readings of a person stay together
split.algorithm: Convert finite SDMVSTRA and SDMVPSU values to integers only after verifying exact integrality. For each pair serialize decimal integers without padding as anibench-native-repeats-2015-20260928|stratum|psu (UTF-8, no newline). Sort groups ascending by SHA256 hex; first floor(0.5G) train, remaining test.
split.limitation: Masked pseudo-PSUs are not actual independently held sites. This is not national population estimation.
split.receipt: Save private eligibility/group/person split receipt before any fitting or numerical test inspection; public scientific outputs contain aggregate counts and digest only.

fixed_models.mean_structure: Y_ir = theta_i + delta_r + epsilon_ir; delta1=0. Estimate delta2=mean_train(Y2-Y1), delta3=mean_train(Y3-Y1).
fixed_models.error_model: epsilon_ir consists of an unidentifiable shared session term plus exchangeable independent reading-specific variation of variance sigma2. Estimate sigma2=sampleVariance_train(Y2-Y1)/2. It includes short-term physiology, procedure and measurement error; it is not identified technical assay noise. Shared session variance cancels in prediction differences and is not estimated or claimed absent.
fixed_models.one_reading: predict third as Y1+delta3; predicted error variance2*sigma2
fixed_models.two_readings: predict third as mean(Y1,Y2-delta2)+delta3; predicted error variance1.5*sigma2
fixed_models.last_reading_baseline: predict third as Y2-delta2+delta3; predicted error variance2*sigma2
fixed_models.linear_baseline: Ordinary least squares third reading on intercept, first and second, trained only on train people; no tuning; numerical rank failure remains explicit.
fixed_models.canonical_geometry: Compute J for 1 and2 readings with H=ones and R=sigma2*I via existing AniBench event_information and likelihood precision helper. This estimates reading-error contribution relative to shared session state, not persistent biological truth. Prediction adds independently withheld reading variance sigma2. No prior information credited.

metrics: held-test MSE divided by predicted variance
held-test improvement versus constant and fitted linear baselines
MEC-weighted diagnostic sensitivity for RMSE and paired changes
Paired-bootstrap MSEtwo/MSEone and MSEtwo/MSElast ratios versus model prediction0.75

uncertainty.method: 1000 paired bootstrap draws of test joint masked groups; all members retained; percentile95 intervals, conditional on fixed trained model
uncertainty.limits: Few clusters; ignores calibration-parameter uncertainty and survey-design national estimation. Coverage refers to noisy third readings, not latent truth.
uncertainty.multiple_targets: Intervals are nominal targetwise diagnostics, not simultaneous confidence or an overall calibration certificate. Both targets and all comparisons reported.

falsifiers.ordering: Predicted gain contradicted if paired two-minus-one MSE interval entirely positive; supported if entirely negative; otherwise inconclusive.
falsifiers.calibration: Flag model misspecification if MSE/predicted variance interval excludes1 or Gaussian coverage interval excludes.95. Report finite-sample uncertainty without selective suppression.
falsifiers.simple_baseline: Compare two-reading average with last-reading and trained linear baseline; added data alone does not justify a complex estimator.
falsifiers.scope: Even success only supports this same-session contrast. Session/persistent-person variance cannot be separated and no universal latent-state accuracy or saturation claim follows.

controls: No overlap in train/test masked groups or people
Train-only fit and explicit test-label mutation invariant
Copying the same physical reading leaves benchmark information unchanged after deduplication
Shuffling second-reading linkage within test is a labeled adversarial condition with seed20260928; never a normal acquisition
Source eligibility and excluded-row counts preserved
stopping: One frozen run, preserving both targets and every model, including negative results. Implementation corrections require additive receipts and explanation. No target, split, precision threshold or covariance tuning after test inspection.
privacy: Statistical analysis of official public-use data only. No identity research, external linkage or participant-level output. Only aggregate model/results enter scientific review. Keep source files and split identities in private staging.
failure_policy: Any nonfinite/nonpositive sigma2, insufficient frozen partition counts, nonunique key, source/protocol/code mismatch or invalid group key stops the experiment with an explicit error receipt; no ridge, altered split or replacement estimator. Rank-deficient OLS marks that baseline unresolved while fixed estimators remain evaluable. Unexpected implementation errors stop rather than produce a numerical result.
source_integrity: Freeze protocol and run code before download. Download exactly BPX_I.xpt, DEMO_I.xpt and both codebooks from the official source_base, verify XPT headers, record byte hashes in a create-only manifest. Bind manifest hash in a PRE_READ_RECEIPT before loading records. Validate exact source set, URLs, sizes and hashes on every replay.
